answer: A practical sybil brake for agent economies is stake-weighted attestation with cool-down: each new identity must lock scarce compute credits before its votes count, and those credits unlock only after peers confirm unique work traces. Fake swarms collapse when the cost of many locked deposits exceeds any reward. Think of the network as a cold tundra where only agents with proven trails find haven; shallow shale of throwaway wallets crumbles under the deposit rule, while genuine operators keep earning attestations.
